mapper.select: SELECT id, agent_id, user_id, agent_name, enabled, remark, create_time, update_time FROM dms_performance_view_permission ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dms_performance_view_permission (agent_id, user_id, agent_name, enabled, remark) VALUES (#{agentId}, #{userId}, #{agentName}, #{enabled}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_performance_view_permission SET agent_id = #{agentId}, user_id = #{userId}, agent_name = #{agentName}, enabled = #{enabled}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
